{{Quote|Perhaps you failed to pay attention to the Senate orientation. They should have explained that Toydaria is a neutral system.|Katuunko, King of Toydaria, to Alderaanian Galactic Senator Bail Organa|<ref name="SL" />}}
'''Toydaria''' was a large, muddy [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Toydaria system/Legends|Toydaria system]] of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], and [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]]-resistant [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarians]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:ToydariaSurface-SL.png|thumb|left|220px|The muck-lake surface of Toydaria.]]
The Toydarian homeworld was covered with nutrient-rich muck-lakes, which supported clouds of [[Insect/Legends|bugs]] and mats of [[Algae/Legends|algae]] and a number of predators including dangerous [[grabworm]]s. Monsoons and [[Fungus/Legends|fungal]] diseases ravage the planet, and can often kill off growing stocks of agriculture.<ref name="Atlas" /> Sustenance for the [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] on Toydaria was so great that on average every 30 [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] depending on weather cycles, shortages would occur and the Toydarians would steal or even [[Poison/Legends|poison]] their neighbor's food supply, under the belief that if they couldn't have it, no one should.

Toydarians considered other planets to be bland and odorless.<ref name="Atlas" />

==History==
[[File:ToydariaPalace-SL.png|thumb|left|220px|The royal palace on Toydaria.]]
Toydarians were omnivorous, eating from succulent algae to [[Fish/Legends|fish]], and survived by flying virtually everywhere, only landing on the relative safety of algae mats. Toydarians originally lived off the nutrients but later turned to farming.

Toydaria was a vassal planet of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] for millennia and traded with other worlds of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. Toydarian spas were visited by the Hutts who also hunted [[grabworm]]s for sport (but otherwise were annoyed by the stinging insects).<ref name="Atlas" />

Because there were so many Toydarians flying around on their home world, the use of [[Airspeeder/Legends|speeders]] was illegal. Only a few craft were allowed to fly in the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], like [[Seltiss-2 caravel|Hutt caravels]];<ref name="Atlas" /> traffic was only allowed to land or take off in specified areas to avoid collisions. To help travel around their world, Toydarians created a light-rail system that took them from city to city. Very little galactic-level technology was incorporated on Toydaria because most Toydarians preferred to live in below galactic-standard villages.

Toydaria was neutral during the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Around this time, Toydaria was ruled by [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]], who, despite his neutrality, entered into an agreement with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to allow them to use Toydaria as a base to deliver supplies to the besieged [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] during the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], following a visit by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] and [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]],<ref name="SL">{{TCW|Supply Lines}}</ref> and then to build a base on his territory, following [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda's]] [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|mission]] on the coral moon of [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]].<ref name="Ambush" /> Later during the war, around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Katuunko was sought out by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], who wanted to force the Toydarian monarch to join the Confederacy through the use of his new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]. However, Opress accidentally killed the king following an [[Showdown at Toydaria/Legends|engagement]] with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="WOTM">{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}}</ref> 

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], Toydaria hosted an Imperial customs fleet formed from remnants of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Winstel Greelanx|Greelanx's]] task force after the [[Battle of Nar Shaddaa (4 BBY)|Battle of Nar Shaddaa]].<ref>[[Lords of Nal Hutta|''Lords of Nal Hutta'']]</ref>

During their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the galaxy, the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Attack on the Toydaria system|landed]] on Toydaria as part of their advance into Hutt Space. However, they encountered heavy resistance from the Toydarians, who had gained assistance from smugglers and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Toydaria_TEA.jpg|thumb|Toydaria]]
Toydaria received its first in-universe appearance in "[[Supply Lines]]," the third episode of the third season of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.
